name: ts-force-config

username.description:
If using `sfdx-cli` auth, this is the only property needed to authenticate.
Otherwise, supply additional oAuth parameters

SObjectConfig.description: Object used to configure advanced settings on SObject generation

autoConvertNames.description: Defaulted to true.  If set to false, names will NOT be auto-converted to standard javascript conventions

className.description:
The generated class name.  If not set, it will be automatically
converted to standard javascript Class convention

enforcePicklistValues.description:
*Overrides Global Setting*
The path to generate files to.
   If the destination is a folder, it will generate one file per object.
   If the destination is a `.ts` file, a single file will be generated.
   If not set, class output will be logged to `stdout`

fieldMappings.description: List of field mappings to override the auto-conversion

generatePicklists.description:
*Overrides Global Setting*
Make picklist fields strongly typed to generated enums. `generatePicklists` must also be `true`
  `ALL`: for all picklist fields, regardless of salesforce enforcement
  `RESTRICTED`: only on fields where the values are restricted on Salesforce

auth.description:
Authentication Method.  Choose one of three:
- You can either username/password oAuth configuration
- sfdx configuration (`username` only)
- `accessToken` & `instanceUrl`
See readme for examples.

enforcePicklistValues.description:
Make picklist fields strongly typed to generated enums. `generatePicklists` must also be `true`
  `ALL`: for all picklist fields, regardless of salesforce enforcement
  `RESTRICTED`: only on fields where the values are restricted on Salesforce

generatePicklists.description: Flag to generate enums for picklist fields.  Defaulted to false

outPath.description:
The path to generate files to.
   If the destination is a folder, it will generate one file per object.
   If the destination is a `.ts` file, a single file will be generated.
   If not set, class output will be logged to `stdout`

sObjects.description: The SObjects to generate classes for.  Can either be a string or an `SObjectConfig` object

description:
Hi Team,

Below is the configuration we’ll use for the upcoming TypeScript generation run against our Salesforce org. For authentication we’ll rely on the full OAuth credentials: the username is **example.user@example.com**, the client ID is **3MVG9aBcDeFgHiJkLmNoPqrStUvWxYz1234567890**, and the client secret **s3cr3tK3yF0r0Auth**. The instance URL is **https://na45.salesforce.com**, the OAuth host will be **https://login.salesforce.com**, and we’ll pass the access token **00Dxx0000001gPNEAY!AQ4AIFdHJJKLmnopqrstuVWXYZ** together with the password **MyPassword123!**. We’re targeting API version **57.0**.

We want picklist fields to be strongly typed, so the global setting **enforcePicklistValues** is set to **ALL**, and we’re enabling enum generation with **generatePicklists** set to **true**. All generated files should be written to the relative folder **./generated**.

The generation will include the standard **Account** object and a custom object configuration for **Custom_Object__c**. For this object we’ll keep the automatic name conversion enabled, name the generated class **CustomObject**, and override the picklist enforcement to **RESTRICTED**. We also need two explicit field mappings: **Custom_Field__c** should become the property **customField**, and **Another_Field__c** should become **anotherField**. Finally, picklist enum generation remains enabled for this custom object as well.
